full_prompt_en: A square graphic painting shows a young man sitting low at the center of a vivid pink, circular grove beneath dark branching trees. A pale stone-colored ground occupies the narrow bottom strip, marked with rough blue-gray strokes and a broad black shadow beneath him. Behind the figure, saturated rose-pink color forms a glowing round field. Dark navy branches bend around its upper edge, their small leaves clustering into irregular silhouettes, while pale jagged lines flicker through the pink area like lightning. Blue and lavender paint marks gather near the lower sides of this circle, bridging it to the ground. The man sits with both knees bent high and spread apart, his forearms resting across them and his hands meeting near the center. He wears an open off-white shirt over a dark top, loose blue trousers, and pale sneakers with ocher laces and accents. His hair stands in short uneven twists, and he tilts his dark face upward and to the left, away from the viewer. Firm angular shadows shape his neck, hands, trouser folds, and the undersides of the shoes. The seated body is a stable dark center against the luminous pink field, while the branches make a rough arch over his head. Ink-like outlines, painterly smears, and splashed patches remain visible throughout; the color boundaries are energetic rather than mechanically smooth. Light is diffuse within the pink backdrop but more directional on the figure, catching the white shirt and shoes and leaving his face in deep shadow. The overall composition is bold and circular, balancing a quiet grounded pose with electric color, branching movement, and broad graphic contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形绘画呈现一名年轻男子低坐在中央，身后是深色枝树之下鲜亮粉色的环形树林。狭窄的底部是一条浅石色地面，带有粗略蓝灰色笔迹和男子身下一大片黑影。人物后方，浓郁玫瑰粉形成发亮的圆形色域。深海军蓝树枝沿其上缘弯曲，小叶聚成不规则剪影；浅色锯齿线在粉色区域中像闪电一样闪动。蓝色与淡紫色涂痕聚集在圆形下方两侧，把它接到地面。男子双膝高高弯起并向两侧分开，两只前臂架在膝上，双手在中央附近相接。他在深色上衣外穿敞开的灰白衬衫，配宽松蓝裤与带赭色鞋带和重音的浅色运动鞋。短而不齐的发束竖起，深色面孔向左上仰起，避开观者。明确的棱角阴影塑造他的脖颈、手、裤褶与鞋底。坐姿身体是发亮粉色区域前稳定的深色中心，枝条则在头顶形成粗糙拱形。类似墨线的轮廓、绘画涂抹与飞溅色斑遍布画面；色彩边界充满能量，并不机械平滑。粉色背景里的光是漫散的，人物受光则更有方向，照亮白衬衫与鞋，让脸部留在深影中。整体构图大胆而呈环形，以安静、贴地的姿势对照电光般的色彩、枝条动势与宽阔图形反差。
style_prompt_en: The graphic painting places saturated rose pink and cool cyan-blue against deep black-navy masses, with small off-white and ocher accents. A bright central field is encircled by branching dark marks, giving the composition a strong rounded rhythm while irregular strokes keep it loose. Shapes are simplified into broad angular planes, yet expressive ink-like contour, dry brush, splatter, and scuffed pigment retain the energy of handwork. Lighter zigzags cut through the saturated color as thin electric lines. Dark shapes ground the lower area and frame the upper edge, allowing the most vivid color to glow between them. Illumination is built chiefly from adjacent color and value rather than realistic reflected light; selected pale planes add local volume. The overall effect is vivid, rhythmic, and streetwise, combining a calm center with turbulent painted surroundings.
style_prompt_zh: 图形绘画把饱和玫瑰粉与冷青蓝置于深黑海军蓝团块前，并加入少量灰白与赭色重音。明亮中央色域被分枝状深色笔迹环绕，形成强烈圆形节奏，不规则涂痕又让它保持松动。形体简化为宽阔棱角平面，富于表情的墨线轮廓、干刷、飞溅与擦损颜料却保留手作能量。浅色锯齿线像细电光一样切过饱和色彩。深色形状稳住下部并框住上缘，让最鲜亮的颜色在其间发光。照明主要由相邻色彩和明度构建，而非写实反射光；少数浅色平面增添局部体积。整体效果鲜活、有节奏且带街头气息，在安静中心与翻涌的绘画周围之间建立对比。
theme_en: A seated young man before a vivid pink circular grove
theme_zh: 鲜亮粉色环形树林前席地而坐的年轻男子
name: Ronald Wimberly
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
